authority: lexical observed-call categories only; not necessity or private-reasoning inference
limitations: a source lookup can be justified
absence of these searches is not proof no archaeology occurred

flaggedCalls.command: rg -n "NORM|TOKEN-NORMALIZE|--acronym|acronym" . --glob '!node_modules/**' --glob '!ai/directives/sdd-v2/**' | head -50; ls -la; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | head -60
ls -la; printf '\n--- ai/directives dirs ---\n'; ls ai/directives/coding 2>/dev/null; ls ai/directives/testing 2>/dev/null

rg -n 'УДАЛИ|\[One-line|\[Опционально|\[<ACR>|<ModuleName>|<this-module>|<module>|<path>|\[Per `DBC' specs/token/normalize/normalize.spec.md || true; printf '
--- non-section comments ---
'; rg -n '<!--(?!SECTION|/SECTION)' -P specs/token/normalize/normalize.spec.md || true; printf '
--- git status ---
'; git status --short
grep -R "module spec's own acronym\|own acronym\|ACR" -n ai/directives/sdd-v2 | head -40
ls ai/directives; ls ai/directives/testing 2>/dev/null; ls ai/directives/coding 2>/dev/null
ls specs specs/token 2>/dev/null; echo ---; ls ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats
find specs -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort; echo ---; cat specs/README.md
wc -l specs/token/token.spec.md ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/diagram-vocabulary.xml && find specs/token -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort
find specs -maxdepth 5 -type f | sort && echo '---' && ls ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats
find ai/directives/coding ai/directives/testing -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | head -80

git status --short && echo '---' && git diff --stat && echo '--- placeholders/guidance ---' && rg -n 'УДАЛИ ПОСЛЕ|<ModuleName>|<module>|<ACR>|<scope>|TODO|<!-- Содержимое|\[One-line|\[Опционально|\[Per |\[All |\[Full |\[<ACR>|\[<yyyy|<list|<path>|<rule|<framework|<lang>|<name>|<component>|<not-closed|<platform>|<ext>' specs/token/pipeline/normalize/normalize.spec.md || true
ls -la specs/token && printf '\n--- tree ---\n' && find specs/token -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort

ls -la && printf '
--- package ---
' && (cat package.json 2>/dev/null || true) && printf '
--- tsconfig ---
' && (cat tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null || true)
find ai/directives -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort && printf '\n--- other dirs ---\n' && find docs .claude -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort
git status --short && printf '\n--- guidance scan ---\n' && rg -n "УДАЛИ ПОСЛЕ ЗАПОЛНЕНИЯ|\[Per |<ModuleName>|<ACR>|TBD|TODO|PLACEHOLDER" specs/token/pipeline/normalize/normalize.spec.md || true
ls -la && git status --short && ls specs 2>/dev/null && ls specs/token 2>/dev/null
ls ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/ && ls specs/token && ls specs/token/normalize
ls ai/directives; echo ---; ls ai/directives/coding ai/directives/testing 2>/dev/null
ls ai/directives/coding 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls ai/directives/testing 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls specs/token; find specs/token -maxdepth 3 -type d
ls -a; echo '---'; test -f package.json && cat package.json || echo 'no package.json'; echo '---'; ls ai/directives/testing; echo '---'; sed -n '1,40p' ai/directives/testing/node-test.xml
ls -la && find specs -maxdepth 4 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50 && ls ai/directives/sdd-v2
ls ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats && ls specs/token/pipeline/normalize && git status --porcelain
cat package.json; find specs -type f; find ai/directives -maxdepth 2 -type d
ls ai/directives && ls ai/directives/coding 2>/dev/null; ls ai/directives/testing 2>/dev/null; ls specs
ls docs && find docs -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -20

ls -R specs | head -100; echo ---; grep -rln "<!--SECTION:MODULE_REQUIREMENTS-->" specs | head -20; echo ---; ls ai/directives/coding ai/directives/testing 2>/dev/null; echo ---; ls ai/directives/sdd-v2
grep -rn "Contract id=\"DECISION_LOG_ENTRY_FORMAT\"" ai | head; echo ---; cat package.json; echo ---; grep -rn "DECISION_LOG_ENTRY_FORMAT" ai/directives/sdd-v2/*.xml | head
ls specs specs/token 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats
ls; echo '---'; cat package.json 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls specs/token/pipeline; echo '---'; ls specs/infra-base
ls -la && echo "---" && find specs -maxdepth 5 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50 && echo "---" && ls ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats 2>/dev/null
ls -R docs inputs ai | head -80; echo "---"; cat specs/README.md; echo "---"; cat package.json
find ai/directives/sdd-v2/guides docs -type f | head -50; echo "---"; grep -rn "module.*acronym\|ACR.*module\|pipeline" ai/directives/sdd-v2 docs 2>/dev/null | head -30
git status --short && echo "---" && find specs/token/pipeline -type f
ls ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/ && ls specs/token/ && cat specs/token/token.spec.md 2>/dev/null | head -80
grep -n "FILE_STRUCTURE\|src/\|typescript\|vitest\|jest\|node" specs/token/token.spec.md; ls; cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls src 2>/dev/null
ls ai/directives/coding ai/directives/testing 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "Language\|Test framework\|typescript\|vitest" specs/ | head -30
ls specs/token; find specs/token -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort
find ai/directives -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort; find ai/directives/coding ai/directives/testing -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort
cat package.json; cat specs/pipeline.spec.md 2>/dev/null || true; find specs -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort
git status --short; git diff --stat; grep -n 'УДАЛИ\|<ModuleName>\|<module>\|<ACR>\|\[Per\|\[One-line\|\[Опционально\|TODO\|placeholder' specs/token/pipeline/normalize/normalize.spec.md || true
ls -la; find ai -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,120p'

rg -n "DECISION_LOG_ENTRY_FORMAT|AX_SPEC_PROGRESSIVE_DISCLOSURE|FOLD_REQUIRED|MODULE_REQUIREMENTS|No module-specific requirements" ai/directives/sdd-v2/root.directive.xml ai/directives/sdd-v2/*.xml | sed -n '1,160p'
cd . && find specs -type f | head -50 && cat package.json
cd . && ls ai/directives && ls ai/directives/coding 2>/dev/null; ls ai/directives/testing 2>/dev/null
cat package.json && ls docs && find docs inputs -type f
find ai/directives/coding ai/directives/testing -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null; ls ai/directives

cat README.md; printf '
---
'; ls -la; printf '
--- package ---
'; cat package.json 2>/dev/null; printf '
--- ai dirs ---
'; ls ai/directives/coding ai/directives/testing 2>/dev/null
git log --oneline -10; printf '\n---files---\n'; git ls-files | head -60
git status --short; printf '\n--- placeholders ---\n'; grep -n "УДАЛИ\|<ModuleName>\|<ACR>\|\[<\|TODO\|TBD" specs/token/pipeline/normalize/normalize.spec.md || true
git diff -- specs/token/token.spec.md specs/README.md specs/infra-base/infra-base.spec.md; ls -l specs/token/pipeline/normalize/normalize.spec.md
